title: Newhalo help centre
description: A help centre on paper: white topic tiles in a two-column grid on the left (the chosen one orange; a sideways-scrolling row on phones), and on the right the topic's 64px heading over a black-hairline accordion with white plus tiles. Questions fade in as they scroll into view; phones end with a 'can't find it?' prompt.
notes: switching topics needs JavaScript (hydrate: visible); the accordion itself works without
